facts.fact: 帽子匠的后院里立着一台巨型机器，数十名灰皮肤、目光呆滞的幽灵村民被驱使着围绕机器不停劳作。
facts.anchor: as several dozen ghostly villagers hurried about its grassy base in ceaseless motion

facts.fact: Allie 坚持独自去破坏机器，理由是国王的力量对机器无效、靠近会有危险；国王抓住她的手臂，拒绝让她单独行动。
facts.anchor: “I have to do this alone,” I insisted. “Your powers don’t work against the machines, remember?

facts.fact: Allie 靠近机器时产生强烈的熟悉感，认定这台奇妙机器是她自己的作品。
facts.anchor: I felt intimately connected to every single part of this fantastic machine.

facts.fact: 将军（并非帽子匠）在平台上现身，称 Allie 为「Carter 博士」，并声称她过去为他工作、是他们那个世界里举世闻名的科学家。
facts.anchor: “She works for me,” he supplied, his eyes bright. “Rather, she used to work for me.” He gave me a wink.

facts.fact: 帽子匠撑着黑伞从古树洞里现身；众人原以为他被将军胁迫，但实际上他已与将军结盟。
facts.anchor: But it appeared as though he had formed an alliance with the man.

facts.fact: Tannis 从背后抱住 Allie，她凭声音和气味认出他、并意识到他不是幽灵，却无法挣脱。
facts.anchor: That voice, the scent of damp wool and sweat. It was Tannis. He wasn’t a ghost like the others.

facts.fact: 帽子匠用一道电光魔法把国王变成白兔；将军随即拎起兔子后颈，宣布机器即将首次启动；国王在心里命 Allie 逃走，她拒绝。
facts.anchor: Where the king had stood only moments before, a small, fluffy white rabbit sat on the grass.

facts.fact: 将军说过去这几个月里没有一天不想起 Allie，即使她头发变了也能认出她。
facts.anchor: there hasn’t been a single day these past months when I haven’t thought of you
